projectTitle: Aegis: Autonomous On-Chain Risk & Dimensional Warehouse Engine
domain: Data Warehousing (Star Schema OLAP) + Data Mining + ERC-4337
abstractText: An enterprise-grade Data Warehousing & Data Mining intelligence engine architected with a Kimball Star Schema and SCD Type 2 in columnar DuckDB (indexing 4,000+ atomic DEX transactions with sub-12ms queries), combined with unsupervised Isolation Forest rug-pull anomaly detection (38ms), K-Means wallet clustering (Silhouette s=0.6512), and FP-Growth token basket mining driving automated ERC-4337 on-chain circuit breakers.
literatureSurveyText: Surveyed Kimball (2013) dimensional star schema, Raasveldt & Mühleisen (2019) DuckDB vectorization, Liu et al. (2008) Isolation Forest, and Han et al. (2000) FP-Growth itemset mining.
